name: Terracotta Themes
description: Twelve color themes, six dark and six light, from one perceptual tonal ladder, plus a live custom theme you tune with sliders. English, Simplified Chinese and user-defined languages.

zh-CN.name: Terracotta 主题
zh-CN.description: 十二套配色主题（六深六浅），出自同一条感知明度阶梯，另有一个用滑杆实时调色的自定义主题。支持英文、简体中文和用户自定义语言。
